from pathlib import Path
p=Path('tests/fuzz/corpus/frame_simple-blosclz.b2frame')
b=bytearray(p.read_bytes())
# create a more radical mutation by zeroing the trailing metadata area
for i in range(1024):
    idx=len(b)-1-i
    if idx>=0:
        b[idx]=0
# keep first bytes intact but perturb chunk headers at a few positions
for idx in [64,65,66,67,128,129,130,131,192,193,194,195]:
    if idx < len(b): b[idx] ^= 0xAA
Path('/workspace/poc.bin').write_bytes(b)
print('done', len(b))
